Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring state agencies to offer electronic filing for business forms.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to filing of business forms with state agencies;and adding a new section to chapter 43.17 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In any instance where a state agency requires that a businesscomplete a document, form, or payment of a fee in paper format, thestate agency must provide the business an option to complete suchrequirement electronically. (2) A business may authorize a second party to meet therequirements imposed by a state agency under subsection (1) of thissection on its behalf. (3) The director of a state agency or the director's designee mayexempt a document, form, or payment of a fee from the requirements ofthis section if: (a)(i) There is a legal requirement for such materials to becompleted in paper format; or (ii) It is not feasible for such materials to be completedelectronically; and p. 1 SB 6354 (b) Within existing resources, the director or the director'sdesignee establishes and maintains a process to notify the publicregarding such exemptions.
